description: A 40x40 box whose background-color reads a declared custom property (--brand) via var(), and whose top border-color reads an undeclared one with a fallback (var(--missing-color, #ff8800)) -- proves both real CSS var() substitution paths resolve correctly all the way through paint, not just at the cascade layer.

florui.css: .card { width: 40px; height: 40px; --brand: #2f7d6c; background-color: var(--brand); border-top-width: 6px; border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: var(--missing-color, #ff8800); }
